all: Chinese Government donates almost $100 million for Sao Tome International Airport Reconstruction Project (Linked to Record ID#55420)
China donates 955,845 million dobras to Sao Tome and Principe for unspecified projects in 2018

Chinese Government cancels $18.4 million of the Government of the STP’s outstanding debt obligations (Linked to Record ID#71266, #55639, #68381, and #55648)

Chinese Government provides $5 million of general budget support to STP (Linked to Record ID#55639)
Chinese Government donates 100,000 Sinovac Covid-19 vaccine doses worth $1.8 million in September 2021
Chinese Government donates 1,000 tons of rice worth $1 million
CIDCA granted 1,000,000 USD in agreement with UNFPA to provide healthcare assistance to Sao Tome and Principe
